## Quiz Answers Wait for Grading

I can't give, confirm, or rule out an answer on quiz 0001 before it's graded — that holds for a practice retake too, even though you're not being scored this time. Neither of your submissions (`s1.json`, `s2.json`) has a grade in `grades/` yet, so q3 is still open territory for you to work out.

## Your Reasoning

Which option are you leaning toward for q3, and why? Walk me through what you think happens to the agent in that scenario if each change were made.

## A Test You Can Run Yourself

For each of the four options, ask the same question: *if this were the only change made, would the situation described in the stem — the agent stuck at step 40, repeating itself — actually stop happening, or could it still happen exactly as described?* Run that test on all four, one at a time, and see which ones survive it.

## Once Graded

Submit both attempts for grading (or ask me to grade them) and I'll go through q3 — and anything else you got wrong — in full, right/wrong/why for every option.
